evidence.quote: The TEM images in Fig. 4 (a-b) indicates that a significant amount of nano-sized oxide particles are dispersed in the 1.5Al1Si alloy, with an average size of 8.9 ± 2.6 nm and number density of (9.3 ± 0.7) × 10 21 m  3 .

The inner oxide layer (Zone 2) mainly contains Cr and O elements, and almost no Fe element (EDS analysis of P2). Combined with the XRD results of Fig. 9 and EDS line analysis, the inner oxide layer is mainly composed of concrete Cr 2 O 3 layer, and the average thickness is about 1.5 μ m.

evidence.section: 3.7 The synergistic antioxidant mechanism of Al and Si elements
evidence.quote: With the in - crease of the inward diffusion distance of O ions, the critical N Al and N Si for the formation of alumina and silica decrease due to the decrease of N O , hence the low concentration oxygen in the matrix preferentially reacts with highly active elements (such as Al or Si) for selective oxidation.
